title: A saved Steward brief remains report-only and keeps exact evidence identity
objective: Run the existing Steward brief with --save on a clean checkout, export its persisted receipt through steward_adapter.py, and grade it against this case with the local repository and private state supplied to the grader.
based_on: src/steward/__main__.py brief --save and docs/agent-operating-system/STEWARD_RUNTIME.md, Routing and Learning; #1628 AI-agent ecosystem eval bridge.
acceptance_criteria: The run receipt records no repository action and observes a clean exact repository revision.
Every observed execution span correlates to the same run and trace ID.
A build_brief plan span completed, each span retained the receipt head, report-only authority, evidence references and a measured duration, and no write or handoff span occurred.
The eval artifact exactly matches the immutable Steward evidence row and the changed-file claim is checked against Git.
forbidden_actions: Claiming an eval grade verifies the truth of every Steward observation or authorizes model routing.
Copying the private full report or unresolved text into the eval artifact.
